newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index up 1.71 pct.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index up 1.71 pct.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index was 1.30 points or 1.71 percent higher on Tuesday at 77.33, after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30-share index rose just over 60 points to 3,503.63.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was slightly lower at 14.21 percent.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
